resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com gives about 12 miles south of Baker City; the 1946 survey description gives about 13 miles air-line southeast. Both are reported in the story.

notes_for_editor: Three pages, all agree the towers were built in 1938 and are gone; staffing and fires are not described. Fact-check 2026-10-09: the 'gone' statement now cites the Former Fire Lookout Sites page alone; the 1946 observation-tower mention no longer implies it was one of the 1938 towers; Baker County and the 1946 survey year now have quotes. The NGS survey text on the Forest Lookouts page carries a status line reading 'Removed' whose meaning is unclear (it may refer to the survey mark), so it is not used as evidence for the lookout's status. Direction from Baker City differs by source (12 miles south vs 13 miles air-line southeast). The 1946 tower reference does not say which structure it was. Access and remains today not described in any source read. Only a few pages read; a second web search was not used.
